_source_comment: OPTIONAL and mostly legacy. The device slot now comes from a canonical hostname resolved once and persisted to ~/.local/share/antares-usage/canonical-hostname, so two machines can never silently share a slot. If you already run v1 with a `source` label, keep it here: it seeds the first canonical resolution so this device keeps writing to the slot it already owns. Override at any time with the ANTARES_USAGE_HOSTNAME env var.
_sources_comment: Which local transcript trees to scan. Omit the whole block to auto-discover every supported tool at its default location. Use an array (['claude']) to limit without changing paths, an object to override a path, or set a tool to false to skip it. A configured directory that doesn't exist is skipped with a notice, not an error.
_breakdown_comment: Whether to upload per-model / per-project token maps. The Worker keeps them server-side and its own USAGE_PUBLISH var decides what becomes public, so `true` here does NOT make them public. Set either to false to keep that dimension on this machine entirely — the aggregate numbers still work.
_secret_comment: OPTIONAL. If omitted, the agent reads the bearer from the macOS keychain at (account=$USER, service=antares-sync-usage). Setting it here puts a plaintext secret on disk — prefer the keychain. Store via:  security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s "antares-sync-usage" -w '<bearer>'
